description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Kurunegala District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement and rescheduling of local authority elections in the Kurunegala Administrative District. It references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, provides the original and new election dates, and lists the specific local authorities affected. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes, election scheduling, and electoral commission decisions.
